head.title: Agent Workspace — Cairn Docs
head.description: Run AI coding agents inside Cairn. Use the built-in Cairn Agent for stateful multi-turn coding with a sandboxed shell, approvals, plan mode, goals, background jobs, subagents, skills, and context compaction — or spawn Claude Code, OpenCode, Aider or any CLI binary from a task card.
head.ogDescription: Built-in stateful coding agent with a sandboxed shell, approvals, plan mode, todos, goals, subagents, background jobs, persistent terminals, and context ring. Plus external binary support with live terminal, multi-file editor, and git diff viewer.
head.twitterDescription: Run AI coding agents inside Cairn. Spawn from a task card, watch the terminal, edit files, review the diff.
